statements.sql: SELECT id, status FROM jobs WHERE id=?1
SELECT id, project, ticket_id, stage, status, budget_usd, spent_usd, updated_at FROM jobs WHERE id=?1
SELECT MAX(id) AS hi FROM wakes

SELECT * FROM wakes WHERE id > ?1 AND id <= ?5
           AND (lower(repo) IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2))
                OR kind IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?3)))
         ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?4
SELECT * FROM ledgers WHERE kind=?1 AND key=?2

SELECT key, status, job_id, created_at, updated_at FROM ledgers
            WHERE kind='merge' AND status='merged' AND created_at>=?1
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3000

SELECT a.artifact_kind AS artifact_kind, a.artifact_ref AS artifact_ref,
                  a.job_id AS job_id, a.created_at AS created_at, a.updated_at AS updated_at,
                  j.project AS project, j.ticket_id AS ticket_id, j.created_at AS job_created_at,
                  j.kind AS job_kind
             FROM job_artifacts a JOIN jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id
            WHERE a.artifact_kind IN ('pr_url','verdict') AND a.updated_at>=?1
            ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 6000

SELECT key, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ledgers
            WHERE kind='pr_state' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT key, status, detail, created_at, updated_at FROM ledgers
            WHERE kind='deploy' AND created_at>=?1
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT project, ticket_id, MIN(issue_created_at) AS issue_created_at,
                      MIN(first_spawn_at) AS first_spawn_at
                 FROM jobs
                WHERE kind='build' AND issue_created_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND first_spawn_at IS NOT NULL AND first_spawn_at>=?1
                GROUP BY project, ticket_id LIMIT 3000

SELECT ts, stage, project, ticket, cost_usd, run_id FROM cost_rows
          WHERE ts >= ?1 AND COALESCE(cost_usd,0) > 0 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT key AS pr_url, updated_at AS merged_at FROM ledgers
    WHERE kind='merge' AND status='merged' AND updated_at>=?1
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?2

SELECT key, status, json_extract(detail,'$.pr') AS pr, updated_at FROM ledgers
    WHERE kind='main_red_attrib' AND updated_at>=?1
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?2
SELECT key, status, detail FROM ledgers WHERE kind='spend_p99'

SELECT project, kind, status, MAX(updated_at) AS at FROM jobs
            WHERE updated_at >= ?1 AND status != 'running'
            GROUP BY project, kind, status

SELECT stage, lane_id, runner, billing_mode, COUNT(*) AS calls,
  SUM(cost_usd) AS usd_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= ?2 THEN cost_usd END) AS usd_24h,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= ?3 THEN cost_usd END) AS usd_today,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cost_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced,
  SUM(CASE WHEN row_source = 'refused' AND COALESCE(note, '') NOT LIKE 'refused:call-guard%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r_gate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(note, '') LIKE 'refused:call-guard%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r_guard,
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(note, '') LIKE '%context-kill:%' OR COALESCE(note, '') LIKE '%cliff-avoided:%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r_ctx
FROM cost_rows WHERE ts >= ?1
GROUP BY stage, lane_id, runner, billing_mode

SELECT l.key AS key, j.project AS project, MAX(l.updated_at) AS at
             FROM ledgers l LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = l.job_id
            WHERE l.kind = 'merge' AND l.status = 'merged' AND l.updated_at >= ?1
            GROUP BY l.key, j.project

SELECT box, auth_account AS account, SUM(COALESCE(cost_usd,0)) AS usd, COUNT(*) AS calls
             FROM cost_rows WHERE ts>=?1 AND ts<?2
            GROUP BY box, auth_account LIMIT 500

SELECT key, created_at FROM ledgers
            WHERE kind='merge' AND status='merged' AND created_at>=?1
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS day, project, kind,
                COUNT(*) AS jobs,
                SUM(COALESCE(spent_usd, 0)) AS spent_usd,
                SUM(COALESCE(budget_usd, 0)) AS budget_usd,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status='orphaned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphaned
           FROM jobs WHERE created_at >= ?1
          GROUP BY day, project, kind
          ORDER BY day DESC, spent_usd DESC
